panels.description: An amber signal pulses through Keel's pump hall, rail gate, Halyard and Oasis as a connected infrastructure path. Keep the upper line clear.
In an Oasis control room, Mera sees the Legacy Protocol alert on a cold display. Keep the upper display clear.
Mera aligns a glass of water with the desk edge, then stops correcting it. Keep the upper desk clear.
A cold tracking ring closes around the amber signal moving toward Site 6. Keep the upper display clear.

items.text: LEGACY PROTOCOL DETECTED — SOURCE: KEEL SECTOR.
